boundary.description: From the junction of Thicketford Road and Blair Lane, along Blair Lane, New Lane, Stitch-Mi-Lane, Arthur Lane, to and S along Bolton – Bury District boundary and River Irwell then River Croal to Hall Lane. W along Hall Lane and by a bee-line to River Croal (including Crompton Lodge Caravan Park), continuing W along River Croal, River Tonge to Folds Road and by a bee-line to and along Entwistle Street, Ainsworth Lane, Abington Road (both sides in St Brendan’s Parish), Crompton Way and Thicketford Road to its junction with Blair Lane.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between St Osmund and St Teresa
internalBoundaries.description: From the point on the Bolton – Biry District boundary opposite Crows Nest and by a bee-line W to Crows Nest, Radcliffe Road, Croft Side and by E boundary of Darcy Level Gravel Pits to River Croal
